title: Malware types (viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware)
solution_py:
"""Reference solution for 4.1.a. MUST pass 100% of the tests.
Also the default 'blackbox' implementation students can swap out (see the hidden grading tests)."""


def solve(report: str) -> str:
    """Classify malware by behavioral signature report.

    Args:
        report: A string containing the incident report description.

    Returns:
        The malware category string: "virus", "worm", "trojan", "ransomware", or "unknown".
    """
    if not isinstance(report, str):
        return "unknown"

    report_lower = report.lower()

    # Priority order: worm > ransomware > trojan > virus > unknown

    # 1. worm
    worm_indicators = [
        "scanning", "self-propagat", "autonomous", "no user action",
        "spreading across network", "network scan", "subnet scan",
        "port scan", "exploiting vulnerab"
    ]
    if any(ind in report_lower for ind in worm_indicators):
        return "worm"

    # 2. ransomware
    ransomware_indicators = [
        "encrypt", "ransom", "decryption key", "locked", ".locked",
        "bitcoin", "btc", "pay to recover", "files inaccessible"
    ]
    if any(ind in report_lower for ind in ransomware_indicators):
        return "ransomware"

    # 3. trojan
    trojan_indicators = [
        "backdoor", "keylog", "exfiltrat", "disguised", "fake installer",
        "remote control", "command and control", "c2", "sending keystrokes",
        "free crack", "pirated"
    ]
    if any(ind in report_lower for ind in trojan_indicators):
        return "trojan"

    # 4. virus
    virus_indicators = [
        "host file", "infected file", "macro", "attachment infected",
        "spread copies", "shared folder infect", "email attachment",
        "copied to usb", "file infect"
    ]
    if any(ind in report_lower for ind in virus_indicators):
        return "virus"

    return "unknown"
